title: 第11章 仙丹炼成异界大日紫气灌注第12章 赤鸦道种正心诀
content_zh:
酒足饭饱之后，“蛇信村”部族的人，给陆羽安排了住宿的地方。
肖玉特意把刘阳和肖汉安排给陆羽做护卫，跟随左右。
他们两跟陆羽还有点交情，肖汉也是肖玉的亲信，有他看着，肖玉比较放心。
蛇信村的堡垒规模不大，里面住的人却是不少，有一千多人，一进门就是闭塞的甬道，到处都要人挤人。
一般的时候，蛇信村部族里的人都是居住在堡垒外，哪怕是自己搭的一个茅草屋，也比堡垒内部的房间宽敞，舒服。
不过，给陆羽准备的房间却是干净明亮，设施齐全，还有一股淡淡的清香，一看就是给部族里身份地位高的人准备的。
陆羽住进这里，并不四处乱逛，只是在屋里待着。
夜色降临之后，肖汉悄咪咪地敲开门，询问道：
“仙师，我家仙师给您安排两个侍女，还请开门.......”
陆羽开门，就见肖汉身后跟着两个娇俏的少女，身穿简单衣袍，却难以掩饰她们身上野性，健康的美。
“她们是我们部族里有名的美人，仰慕仙师之威，愿意全心全意侍奉仙师！还请仙师给他们一个机会！”
两位少女在肖汉介绍她们的时候，朝陆羽盈盈一拜，露出一片雪白之色。
你们就那这个考验仙师？
哪个仙师经不起这样的考验？
若是在一处安全之所，陆羽绝不介意学学异界语，磨砺磨砺自己的意志。
但现在初来乍到，还未有镇压一切的实力，陆羽可不敢放松警惕，沉迷于美色之中。
他也怕这蛇信村的仙师肖玉，给他下毒呢！
要知道，有些毒药可不一定需要口服，身体的黏膜也能吸收药性.......
“我不需要！”
陆羽阴沉脸，拒绝了两位少女的侍奉，在她们哀怨的眼神中关上了房门。

“可惜了，要是仙师接受你们，再留下一些种子，说不定明年我们部族就能多些有天赋的孩子.......”
肖汉一脸惋惜地带着两位部族少女离去。
这位仙师竟然不近女色，真是稀奇。
要知道他们死对头部族里的那位仙师，就像是淫虫入脑了一样，一个人就霸占了部族里所有的女人，天天享乐.......
经常来骚扰蛇信村部族，更是想要将蛇信村部族里的肖玉仙师给带回去，让她生十来个崽子。
堡垒中，肖玉的住所。
肖玉擅长炼药，她的住所里充斥着繁杂的草药味。
一盏烛火微亮，
此时的肖玉正在一口青铜小鼎前炼药，各种部族里寻来的材料。
鲜艳欲滴的花朵，色彩斑斓的蘑菇，干枯的树枝，鹿角，兽皮，黑鸟的眼珠子.......
一个个，按照着玄妙的顺序，一一添加进青铜小鼎中，小鼎下，炭火熊熊燃烧，将这些材料融化成一锅黑漆漆的药膏。
肖玉手持一玉勺，缓缓搅拌鼎中黑乎乎的药膏，一边搅拌，还一边念念有词，给这药膏加持咒法。
情景颇为诡异，陆羽见了怕不是要说一句，老妖婆在熬药了。
不过这个过程也没持续多久，约莫一炷香的功夫，青铜小鼎里的黑色药膏就熬干了水分，成了坚硬的固体，泛着幽幽的紫光。
见到这个模样的成品，因为劳累熬药，脸色更加苍白的肖玉眼冒精光：
“青鼎焚药，熬之以成丹，其色玄幽，丹无异味，成之.......仙书上说的果然没错，我又成了一丹，可喜可贺！”
肖玉捏着鼎中坚硬固体，凑近鼻尖，未闻见任何气味，更加坚信自己炼成了。
丹成之后，肖玉也没急着试丹，而是接见了在门外等候多时的肖汉。
肖汉将刚才的情况，一一复述给肖玉听。
肖玉听完，眼中神光大盛，赞叹道：

“不近女色，辟谷不食，可掌仙光，此乃真仙人也！”
肖玉回想仙书中的记载，与陆羽的情况一一对应，越想越是觉得有道理。
同时，她也坚定了与陆羽打好关系的想法。
想起自己刚才炼得丹药，肖玉一拍手，高兴地道：
“肖汉，你先回去，侍奉陆仙师左右，明日我当拜访陆仙师，与之共品仙丹！”
content_en:
After drinking and eating, the people from the "Shexin Village" tribe arranged a place for Lu Yu to stay.
Xiao Yu specially arranged for Liu Yang and Xiao Han to be Lu Yu's guards and follow them around.
The two of them still have some friendship with Lu Yu, and Xiao Han is also Xiao Yu's confidant. With him watching, Xiao Yu feels more at ease.
The fortress of Shexin Village is not large, but there are quite a lot of people living in it. There are more than a thousand people. As soon as you enter the door, you will find a blocked corridor, and there are crowds of people everywhere.
Normally, the people in the Shexin Village tribe live outside the fortress. Even a thatched house built by themselves is more spacious and comfortable than the rooms inside the fortress.
However, the room prepared for Lu Yu was clean and bright, with complete facilities and a faint fragrance. It seemed that it was prepared for people with high status in the tribe.
Lu Yu lived here and didn't wander around, he just stayed in the house.
After night fell, Xiao Han quietly knocked on the door and asked:
"Master Immortal, my Immortal Master has arranged two maids for you, please open the door..."
Lu Yu opened the door and saw two pretty girls following Xiao Han. They were wearing simple clothes, but it was difficult to hide their wild and healthy beauty.
"They are famous beauties in our tribe. They admire the power of the Immortal Master and are willing to serve the Immortal Master wholeheartedly! Please give them a chance!"
When Xiao Han introduced them, the two girls bowed to Lu Yu Yingying, revealing a white complexion.
Is this how you test the Immortal Master?
Which immortal master can't withstand such a test?
If he were in a safe place, Lu Yu would never mind learning foreign languages ​​and sharpening his will.
But now that he has just arrived and has not yet the strength to suppress everything, Lu Yu dare not let down his guard and indulge in beauty.
He was also afraid that the immortal master Xiao Yu from Shexin Village would poison him!
You know, some poisons do not necessarily need to be taken orally, and the mucous membranes of the body can also absorb the medicinal properties...
"I don't need it!"
Lu Yu had a gloomy face, refused the two girls' service, and closed the door in their sad eyes.
"It's a pity. If the immortal master accepts you and leaves some seeds, maybe next year our tribe will have more talented children..."
Xiao Han left with the two tribal girls with a look of regret.
It is really strange that this immortal master is not close to women.
You must know that the immortal master from their rival tribe is like a worm in his brain. He dominates all the women in the tribe and enjoys it every day...
She often comes to harass the Shexin Village tribe, and even wants to take back the Immortal Master Xiao Yu from the Shexin Village tribe and let her give birth to a dozen cubs.
In the fortress, Xiao Yu's residence.
Xiao Yu is good at refining medicine, and her residence is filled with the smell of complicated herbs.
A candle is dimly lit,
At this time, Xiao Yu was refining medicine in front of a small bronze cauldron, using various materials found in the tribe.
Bright flowers, colorful mushrooms, dry branches, antlers, animal skins, blackbird eyes...
One by one, in a mysterious order, they were added to the small bronze cauldron. Under the small cauldron, the charcoal fire was burning, melting these materials into a pot of dark ointment.
Xiao Yu held a jade spoon in his hand and slowly stirred the dark ointment in the cauldron. While stirring, he muttered words to add spells to the ointment.
The scene was quite strange. When Lu Yu saw it, he was afraid that he would say that the old witch was brewing medicine.
However, this process did not last long. In about the time it took to burn an incense stick, the black ointment in the small bronze cauldron boiled away the water and turned into a hard solid, glowing with a faint purple light.
Seeing the finished product like this, Xiao Yu's eyes gleamed as his face turned even paler due to overwork and boiling medicine:
"Burn the medicine in a green cauldron and boil it to form an elixir. The color is mysterious and the elixir has no peculiar smell. It is... What the fairy book said is indeed correct. I have become an elixir again. I am so happy and congratulations!""
Xiao Yu held the hard solid material in the cauldron and brought it close to the tip of his nose. He didn't smell any smell, which made him even more convinced that he had made it.
After the elixir was completed, Xiao Yu was not in a hurry to try the elixir. Instead, he met Xiao Han who had been waiting outside the door for a long time.
Xiao Han recounted the situation to Xiao Yu one by one.
After hearing this, Xiao Yu's eyes shone brightly and she praised:
"You don't get close to women, you don't eat food, you can control the light of immortals, this is a true immortal!" "
Xiao Yu recalled the records in the fairy book, which corresponded to Lu Yu's situation one by one. The more he thought about it, the more it made sense.
At the same time, she also firmly decided to have a good relationship with Lu Yu.
Thinking of the elixir he had just refined, Xiao Yu clapped his hands and said happily:
"Xiao Han, you go back first and serve Master Lu. Tomorrow I will visit Master Lu and share the elixir with him! "
